A strain is a commonly used name for a cannabis variety or cultivar. Names alone do not guarantee identical genetics or effects.
A cultivar is a cultivated plant variety selected for particular traits.
THC is a cannabinoid associated with intoxicating effects. Actual potency varies by product and laboratory results.
CBD is a cannabinoid that is not typically intoxicating like THC. It can interact with medicines.
Terpenes are aromatic compounds found in many plants. Aroma does not reliably predict a specific medical effect.
A feminized seed is produced to have a high likelihood of developing a female plant, but outcomes are not guaranteed.
An autoflowering cannabis variety generally initiates flowering based more on age than on changing day length.
Photoperiod describes how plants respond to the length of light and darkness.
A landrace is a locally adapted plant population associated with a geographic region and long-term selection.
A hybrid combines genetic ancestry from different lines; labels do not reliably predict experience.
Trichomes are small surface structures; glandular trichomes can produce cannabinoids and terpenes.
Germination is the process by which a viable seed begins growing.
pH measures acidity or alkalinity and influences nutrient availability in growing media.
Electrical conductivity, or EC, is a proxy for dissolved ion concentration in water or nutrient solution.
A phenotype is the observable expression of genetics interacting with the environment.
A genotype is an organism’s genetic makeup.
A seed bank preserves or distributes seeds; specific inventory and shipping policies vary.
A certificate of analysis is a lab report for a tested sample. Check its batch identifier and date.

records.pattern: WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN FEMINIZED AND REGULAR SEEDS
records.template: Feminized seeds are bred to favor female plants. Regular seeds can develop male or female plants.
Pack size is the number of seeds in a product package. Confirm the listing for the exact count.
A breeder develops plant lines by selecting and crossing plants for particular traits.
Yellow leaves can result from aging, watering problems, nutrient imbalance, root stress or pests. Check the pattern and growing conditions before deciding.
Leaf curling may relate to heat, light, water stress or pests. Examine the whole plant and environmental conditions.
Overwatering occurs when excess water reduces oxygen availability around roots. Drainage and watering frequency both matter.
Underwatering occurs when a plant lacks enough available moisture to maintain normal function.

records.pattern: HOW DO I CHECK SOIL PH
records.template: Use a calibrated pH meter or appropriate test kit and follow its instructions for the growing medium.
Root rot can involve pathogens and poorly oxygenated, persistently wet root conditions.
Inspect leaf undersides, stems and the growing medium for insects, eggs, webbing or damage; identify the pest before treatment.
Light stress is plant damage or reduced performance from unsuitable light intensity, duration or heat.
Nutrient lockout is a common grower term for conditions that limit nutrient uptake despite nutrients being present.
For many plant seeds, a cool, dry, dark, stable environment and moisture-resistant packaging support storage longevity.
Improve ventilation, avoid persistent moisture, inspect plant material and keep storage areas clean.

records.pattern: WHY IS MY PLANT NOT GROWING
records.template: Slow growth can involve temperature, light, root health, water, nutrients, genetics or pests. Check the simplest variables first.
Hardening off is gradually acclimating indoor-grown plants to outdoor conditions.
A growing medium supports roots and affects water, oxygen and nutrient availability.
Integrated pest management combines monitoring, prevention and proportionate controls rather than relying on one treatment.
Northern Lights is a longstanding cannabis cultivar family, often described as indica-leaning; exact genetics vary by breeder.
White Widow is a classic cultivar name associated with 1990s Dutch breeding. Different sellers may offer distinct versions.
Skunk #1 is a historically influential hybrid breeding line; modern products bearing the name may differ.
Jack Herer is a classic cultivar named for the cannabis activist and author; exact lineage varies by source.
Haze refers to a family of historically influential cannabis lines, commonly associated with sativa-leaning ancestry.
OG Kush is a well-known cultivar family with disputed or inconsistently documented early lineage.
Blue Dream is a popular cultivar commonly described as Blueberry × Haze, though commercial genetics vary.
Sour Diesel is a longstanding cultivar name associated with pungent diesel-like aroma; its origin stories vary.
Durban Poison is a classic cultivar name associated with South African origins; present-day seed lines differ.
Acapulco Gold is a historic cannabis name associated with the Acapulco region of Mexico.
Panama Red is a historic cannabis cultivar name associated with Panama and older landrace-style lines.
Granddaddy Purple is a well-known purple-flowered cultivar name, commonly associated with Purple Urkle and Big Bud ancestry.
AK-47 is a classic hybrid cultivar name; breeder-specific details should be checked at the source.
Amnesia Haze is a widely known Haze-related cultivar family, with variations among breeders.
